price_note: Public dataset exposes a single Up-token price per market (implied_up_last, near close). Only that offset carries a real price; other offsets are blank rather than synthesised. Run scripts/scrape_btc5m.py on a host with egress for true per-offset UP/DOWN prices.
known_limitations: implied-probability coverage in the source is ~84%
closed markets return only 2-30 price points from the public API
no historical order book is available from Polymarket
